svg.title: The order of choices (schematic)
svg.desc: Schematic: the loss exponents are fixed first; a candidate zero beta > 1/2 is given; theta is chosen between 1/2 and beta; epsilon is chosen so that 1/2 + (e_D+e_L+7) eps <= theta; the arithmetic then supplies windows for that epsilon; the analytic criterion excludes the zero.

svg.text: Why a bound at ε = 0 is never needed: θ is chosen after the zero, and ε after θ

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Lean: Formalism.HC.level_of_tiedWin takes θ = ½ + ½·min(β − ½, ½); the window width is 3/2.
